constraints: Incorporate every coordinate, artifact identity, transformation allowlist, layout, schema, smoke, ownership rule, stop condition, and acceptance gate selected by OVR-000072 unchanged. This refinement adds only the exact archive and RECORD byte grammar below; prefixcommons remains 0.1.12+malleus.1 and this is not a Malleus release decision.
Order archive members and RECORD rows by ascending Unicode code point of final POSIX member names, including the RECORD member and its row. Every final ZIP filename is ASCII.
Encode RECORD as UTF-8 without BOM with exactly three fields, comma delimiter, ASCII double-quote quotechar, doublequote true, QUOTE_MINIMAL, no escapechar, LF line terminator, and a terminal LF.
For every member except RECORD, write sha256=<URL-safe Base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest without '=' padding> and decimal byte length. Leave the RECORD row's own hash and size fields empty.

Set every ZipInfo date_time to 1980-01-01 00:00:00, compress_type to ZIP_STORED, create_system=3, create_version=20, extract_version=20, reserved=0, flag_bits=0, volume=0, internal_attr=0, external_attr=(0o100644 << 16), and extra/comment empty. Set the archive comment empty.

Disable ZIP64 and reject every input or output requiring it. Treat CRC32, compressed and uncompressed sizes, and local-header offsets only as consequences of the exact payloads and member order, never selected inputs.

The implementation must set every selected RECORD, ZipInfo, and archive field explicitly, then reopen the written wheel and validate every selected field and byte. It must not rely on CPython defaults.

Use https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/recording-installed-packages/ and https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/zipfile.html only as factual roots for RECORD semantics and Python 3.12 ZipInfo attributes.
